concept: A cursor becomes a film: the sound arrives first, the picture is cut to it and measured, and it is released at dawn.
law: Blue hour warming to dawn, one warm light, one cool blue for the reference. A serif voice for words and mono only for what is typed. The light is the only thing that ever glows.
motif: One point of light: born from the caret, it draws the sound, marks every cut, is matched against its reference, and rises as the dawn.

options.name: A
options.idea: Blue hour to dawn: a single light moving through depth over a waveform horizon, letterboxed until the payoff.

options.name: B
options.idea: Paper and ink: a ruled sheet where the score is drawn as a staff and frames are pinned like a storyboard.

full width waveform on the centre line

scenes.entrance: rise from the cue ticks, camera dolly

horizon low, title centred above it
